construction: cross-difference cyclic norm and transverse first variations; inverse-affine action followed by a two-call ordinary marked-action bridge
base_identity: for full prime rational group and Q!=+/-G, zero-order norm=c_Q*(x((1-pi)P)-x((1-pi)R)); c_Q=product_(j!=0)(x(jG)-x(jQ))
ordinary_bridge: bG=M_Q(G), Q2=G-bG, output U-M_Q2(U); handle Q=O,+/-G and2Q=G by public point tests
generic_norm_probes: (S,2S),(S,3S),(2S,3S); for p11/17 use declared S; for p211 choose first x in ascending order with y=min positive sqrt(-f(x))*W, S of order greater than10 (none of1..10 times S isO)
constant_controls: c_Q=c_-Q=c_(k^-1 G), by direct products on frozen eligible labels; no injectivity assumption
reference: prefix/suffix cofactor sums compared with square-zero product recurrence; no singular-root search in extraction

P192_local_blocks.input: round52 curve and public Q, Round57 mu_G and relation_lambda_G, Round54 P=6S
P192_local_blocks.U: [j](G-Q), so the singular block term has indexj
P192_local_blocks.scope: 24 selected norm blocks only, no full P192 norm or auxiliary action at arbitrary U

negative_controls: change second graph sign for nonzero U; corrupt a retained coefficient; both reject
AA: not applicable: exact identities, no timing or statistical inference
boundary: compressed zero-order norm does not assert compressed first variations; charge every graph, point, encoding and coefficient step; no novelty claim for standard norms or isogeny facts
